<function name="status" parent="jit" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the status of the JIT compiler and the current optimizations enabled.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Is JIT enabled</ret>
		<ret name="" type="any">Strings for CPU-specific features and enabled optimizations</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
